conditional_TH.question: Does held-risk have standalone value without the cap, or a material interaction?
conditional_TH.run_if: TC does not explain at least 80% of TCH-versus-T maximum-drawdown reduction, OR TCH-versus-TC actual total-return gain is at least 0.02
conditional_TH.otherwise: Stop without TH; a cap-dominated small-fixture result does not justify another cell.
conditional_TH.interpretation: These fixed diagnostics decide research cost, not strategy thresholds or significance; no tuning.
